scripts.build:api:vercel-sim: esbuild api/*.ts handlers/*.ts server/*.ts --outbase=. --outdir=.tmp-vercel --platform=node --format=esm && node -e "import('./.tmp-vercel/api/index.js').then(m => { if (typeof m.default !== 'function') process.exit(1); console.log('PASS Vercel ESM runtime import simulation'); })"
scripts.test:security: esbuild server/security.ts server/file-access.ts server/storage.ts server/origin.ts server/orphan-cleanup.ts server/hr-access.ts server/api-router.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --out-extension:.js=.cjs --outdir=.tmp-test && esbuild utils/idms-response.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=.tmp-test/idms-response.cjs && node --test tests/security.test.cjs
scripts.check: npm run check:function-count && npm run build:api:vercel-sim && npm run test:security && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run bundle:scan
